item.tib: gdugs dkar mo can gyi phyir bzlog pa chen mo rgyud la gtsang gyer gdug pa rngam sgrogs
item.coloph: ces gshen rab mchog de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug gtor nas byung ba'i/ gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo/ rigs sngags rgyal mo'i rgyud las rtsang gyer gdug pa'i rngam sgrogs 'di ni/ kho bo kun grol grags pa bdag gis rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyi byang phyogs rgyas pa'i zhing khams mu khri stag mo rdzong du/ sa rta zla 10ba'i 'phel phyogs su bgyis (pa 'dis) kyang bstan 'gro yi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig/
